title: The Pink Sequin Mini Dress Costume
intro: Sequins are not subtle and this costume does not pretend to be. A hot pink sequin mini with long sleeves, silver glitter kitten heels you can actually stand in all night, a glitter envelope clutch on a chain, layered tassel earrings and heart sunglasses for the one photo everyone will ask you to send them. It is a costume on the thirty-first and a birthday dress the rest of the year, and the sunglasses come in a pair so your best friend matches.
